Name: Kemuel
Summary: Kemuel was a son of Nahor and Milcah, and the father of Aram.
KeyStory: Kemuel's line is noted because his son Aram carried the family name forward.
RelatedPeople: Nahor, Brother of Abraham; Milcah; Aram, Son of Kemuel
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
